title: Return Eligibility Windows and Returnable Items by Ship-To Service Level
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — returns schedule, part one: windows and returnability.** The periods below run from the ship date, the delivery date or the RMA date as stated, and follow the service level of the ship-to the goods were shipped to.

| Service level | Customer-reason return window (calendar days after the ship date) | Defective return window (calendar days after the ship date) | Concealed shipping damage report (business days after delivery) | RMA validity (calendar days after the RMA date) | Special-order item returnable when the manufacturer accepts it | Opened but unused stocked item returnable for a customer reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 30 | 90 | 5 | 15 | no | no |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 30 | 180 | 5 | 15 | no | no |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 60 | 365 | 5 | 30 | no | yes |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 60 | 365 | 7 | 30 | no | yes |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 90 | 365 | 7 | 30 | yes | yes |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 90 | 365 | 10 | 30 | yes | yes |

**Item classes never returnable for a customer reason (every level):** cut-to-length, hazmat and calibrated instrument.

### Definitions

1. *Customer-reason return window* — the calendar days after the ship date within which a stocked item may be returned for a customer reason.
2. *Defective return window* — the calendar days after the ship date within which a defective item may be returned through Corbett.
3. *Concealed shipping damage report* — the business days after delivery within which concealed shipping damage must be reported.
4. *RMA validity* — the calendar days after the RMA date within which the goods must arrive at Corbett.
5. *Special-order item returnable* — whether a special-order item may be returned when the manufacturer accepts it.
6. *Opened item returnable* — whether an opened but unused stocked item may be returned for a customer reason.
7. *Non-returnable item classes* — the item classes never returnable for a customer reason.

### Points of reading

- Only Corbett Premier Route Ship-To and Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To allow a special-order item to be returned, and only when the manufacturer accepts it.
- Corbett Parcel Ship-To and Corbett Standard Ship-To do not allow an opened item to be returned for a customer reason.
- The damage report period is counted in business days and runs from delivery, not from the ship date.
